facts.fact: APS reports that on 2026-10-06 Algeria's and Niger's ministers launched operation at Assamaka of the fibre-optic trans-Saharan backbone linking In-Guezzam (Algeria) to the Arlit-Agadez region (Niger), with 100 Gbps capacity from the start, to carry data traffic between the two countries.

systems.owner: Algérie Télécom and Niger Télécom (built by both)
systems.tiers: national operators of Algeria and Niger
